idea-plugin.name: FASTBuild Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
FASTBuild is an open-source build system that speeds up C/C++ builds through parallel compilation, caching, and distributed compilation across multiple machines.

FASTBuild Monitor visualizes those builds inside your JetBrains IDE. Follow overall progress, see jobs running on local and remote workers, and inspect job status and duration without leaving the editor.

  • Live timeline showing concurrent jobs on each worker.
  • Build statistics for active, successful, cached, and failed jobs.
  • Sortable job list with worker, status, and duration.
  • Automatic log-path detection, with support for custom log files.

Requires FASTBuild running with the -monitor flag. This plugin monitors builds; it does not install FASTBuild or launch builds.
